profile.research_note:
Current operator uncertain following the XO/Verizon 2016-2017 acquisition and Verizon's 2017 Equinix divestiture of 29 legacy data centers; not confirmed whether this specific Fremont facility was included. Revisit with fresh WebSearch budget.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This is the XO Fremont facility, in Alameda County, California. XO Communications was a competitive telecommunications carrier providing fiber network and enterprise data services, historically headquartered in Herndon, Virginia. Verizon acquired XO Communications fiber optic network and enterprise business in a transaction that closed in 2016 and 2017, folding its network and facilities into Verizon broader wireline and enterprise operations. Verizon subsequently sold a portfolio of 29 data centers, drawn from its legacy MCI, UUNET, and XO Communications heritage networks among others, to Equinix in a 3.6 billion dollar deal that closed in May 2017. This research did not confirm specifically whether the Fremont facility was among the 29 data centers included in the Equinix transaction or whether it remained with Verizon or another successor. This record is retained under the historical XO name per registry policy against deleting historical operator entries. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
